comparison.objective: Twist an ice tray to release eight cubes and tip them into a dish.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual opposing twist, inversion, bulk release, and tray replacement.
comparison.success_condition: All eight cubes enter the dish, the tray returns to its starting support pose, and the arms retreat.
comparison.reason: Both create and contain released pieces, but this uses distributed torsional flexure to release pre-existing cubes. The candidate tests coaxial mandrel placement, localized hammer impact at manufactured notches, protection of retained coils, and individual small-fragment recovery.
